quarterly_data.quarter: Sumitomo Electric press release: Sumitomo Electric Holds Opening Ceremony for the UK's First (10-19-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Sumitomo Electric opened the UK's first HVDC subsea cable factory at the Port of Nigg in Scotland on October 19, 2026: a GBP 350 million investment with 58,000 square meters of floor space on a 15-hectare site that will manufacture 525kV XLPE HVDC subsea transmission cables and subsea inter-array cables, creating over 200 skilled local jobs. National Grid says it awarded Sumitomo Electric the contract to supply the HVDC cable for Sea Link, and SSEN Transmission says its proposed Shetland 2 subsea cable project anchored the investment.
quarterly_data.figure: GBP 350 million factory; 525kV XLPE HVDC cables; 58,000 square meters; over 200 jobs
